_how_to_edit: Single source of truth. The public page /roadmap.html shows every item with public:true. The Sunday reminder issue lists ALL items that are not status 'done'. status: in_progress | up_next | evaluating | ongoing | done

items.title: Illinois BEP certification
items.note: Fast-track reciprocal certification through the Commission on Equity and Inclusion, based on our City of Chicago MBE.

items.title: SAM.gov federal registration
items.note: Includes choosing our NAICS codes. Needed to bid on and be paid for federal work.

items.title: NMSDC MBE certification
items.note: National corporate supplier-diversity certification. We are deciding whether it fits our customers.

items.title: Keep our City of Chicago MBE current
items.note: Annual No-Change Affidavit, filed 60 days before the May 1 anniversary.

items.title: Publish certificate of insurance and bonding capacity
items.note: Confirm current general-liability limits and bonding capacity, then post the documents here.

items.title: Past-performance references
items.note: Collect and publish completed-project references (most public bids ask for two or three).

items.title: Training authority (IBHE approval, exemption, or authorized partner)
items.note: Illinois requires IBHE approval for vocational training unless an exemption applies.

items.title: Training site, cohort dates and transit directions
Costs, funding and sponsorship
items.note: Tuition or sponsorship, PPE, transportation help and testing fees. No free seats advertised until funding is secured.

items.title: Support staff and safety providers
items.note: Craig Rainford leads instruction. Still to confirm: lab support, a navigator, and the OSHA 10 and First Aid/CPR/AED providers.

items.title: Outside AWS test facility and employer input
items.note: Agree the test scope with an Accredited Test Facility, and confirm the process (MIG vs stick) with employers.

items.title: Follow up with everyone on the interest list
Fix 'MBE/WBE/DBE' wording in contracts.html
items.note: The City letter certifies MBE only. Remove WBE/DBE claims wherever they appear.

items.title: Verify our City certification directory listing
items.note: The letter says it is our responsibility to check that the listing and NAICS specialties are correct.

items.title: Check info@clrainford.com for [Welding Training Interest] messages
Update the internal program proposal (.docx): 3 seats, Craig as instructor
